text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre has gotten off to a great start 
this year as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was incredible! A comfortable 1st 
place finish in the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That was a truly commanding victory~! 
Brushing aside the GⅠ regulars as if they 
were nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Truly the monarch of the turf! Though she 
had a misstep last year... only she 
possesses that kind of commanding 
presence!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It appears the stable is focusing on the 
"Takarazuka Kinen" as their next target, 
serving as the final race before departing 
for France.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"And now it's time for revenge at the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe! Which means this 
year will be Orfevre's year as well—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooooh--!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Boss, one more lap...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's take a break and try once 
more!

Yeah, let's take a break and try once 
more!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Understood!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, it certainly will. This year will 
belong to Orfevre and the others.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Because in the next Tenno Sho (Spring), 
that sensational duo will be having their 
rematch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Checkpoint"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it begins! The paddock for the "Tenno 
Sho (Spring)"! All the spotlight Umamusume 
are gathered together—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...How unusual. Gold Ship is speechless.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And she's moving so quietly... Wait, is 
that the real Golshi...!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is most likely...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno slipped around next to Gold Ship 
and gave her a poke on the forehead! And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Weeee――ch-ch-ch―― Peeee――whistleee――

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Golshi is making weird noises...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Just as suspected! This is an elaborate 
robot made to look like Gold Ship-san!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno gently sets down the Gold Ship 
Robot (?) on the floor. Then, looking 
towards the stands...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: “—The real one is over there! Take that!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Leaped high into the air!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ksshhhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!? Waaaaah!? The real Gold Ship is 
actually here~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Didn't you find that way too fast?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that your hiding skills 
haven't improved in the slightest?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mukiーーn!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr~~... Woof, woof, BARK!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Golshi's fully in battle mode all 
of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, what even is this! It's 
hilarious, though—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? The wind!? Amazing, out of 
nowhere--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —...I smell something.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The scent of spring. A scent truly 
befitting this land steeped in chance 
encounters and tradition.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Since ancient times, this stage has seen 
off countless Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (――I have seen off so many futures.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Please do as you wish, Golshi-san. 
Otherwise, you wouldn't be you."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, I shall build even more strength 
and surpass you further, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to our future together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Bring it on.
